text: I had a busy day but I'm okay now.
I've been anxious about exams and can't relax.
I feel hopeless and like everyone would be better without me.
I have a suicide plan and I am going to do it tonight.
मुझे बहुत घबराहट हो रही है और मैं बहुत तनाव में हूँ।
Mera stress bahut zyada hai, mujhe kisi se baat karni hai.
I do not want to die; I want help getting through tonight.
